text: Concentration produces instability and dispersion produces stability: the more concentrated a structure is, the more unstable it is, because little changes can cause major structural change, while a spread out pattern remains spread out when disturbed.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Preface to (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782191
abstract: The more concentrated a structure is, the more unstable it is. The more spread out a pattern is, the more stable it is

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: any structure characterized by concentration or dispersion
